messages:
emma: Quick heads-up — planning a coordinated cutover tonight 23:00 UTC. Services: runtime v2.3.1, router v5.1.0, api-gateway v1.9. No DB migrations. Change window 23:00-00:30 UTC. Need console to pin UI to api-v1.9 and disable new telemetry flag. @rajesh @santiago can you confirm readiness?

deploy-bot: Deploy window created: https://deploys.internal/redwood/1719991234 — steps queued (runtime -> router canary -> api pin -> console).

rajesh: Runtime staging perf tests are green. Kernel batching switch exercised; tail latency looked okay. One ask: keep current KV-eviction policy (do not flip eviction tweak tonight).

santiago: Router 5.1 canary config is ready. I'll apply 5% at T0, hold 30m, then 20% -> 100% if stable. Canary config snippet:```
route: /api
variants:
  - name: router-5.1
    weight: 5
  - name: router-5.0
    weight: 95
```
I'll annotate routing metrics in the canary dashboard.

emma: Console team: please pin to api-v1.9 and keep feature flag "new_telemetry" off until +60m. Release notes draft: https://docs.internal/release/1719991234 (I'll publish final 15m before window).

ops-sre: Oncall coverage: ops-sre + luis 23:00-01:00 UTC. Rollback criteria (agreed):
- p95 latency > 300ms sustained for 10min OR
- error rate > 1% for 5min OR
- any SEV impacting model serving.
If triggered, immediate action: revert router traffic to 5.0 and pin api back to v1.8.1. Alerting runhook configured.

luis: Adding quick revert commands to the runbook now. Short commands:```
# revert router to 5.0.9
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/router router=registry.redwood/router:5.0.9
# pin api back to 1.8.1
redwood-control api pin --service api --version 1.8.1
```
Runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/cutovers/1719991234

emma: Cutover plan: T0=runtime deploy + healthcheck, T0+2m router canary 5%, monitor 30m, if stable bump 20% at +30m, full at +60m. No console UI changes until api pin is confirmed. Everyone please ack with :thumbsup: to proceed.

rajesh: :thumbsup: runtime will watch kernel logs and KV warming. Note: cache warm-up may add ~6m of tail latency.

santiago: :thumbsup: I'll watch routing errors, 5xxs, and connection churn.

deploy-bot: Deploy window starts at 1719994800 (23:00 UTC). Tasks executed in order. Audit trail live at: https://deploys.internal/audit/1719991234

emma: If rollback happens, announce in this thread and tag #incidents and follow runbook. Keep release notes updated with rollback reason.

ops-sre: Canary applied at T0: router-5.1=5% (deploy-bot). Initial metrics: small p95 bump (~10ms), p99 steady. No spike in 5xx. Holding for +30m.

luis: Observed cache-hit ratio recovering after runtime deploy (warming). p99 latencies normalized after ~5m.

rajesh: Observing increased load on kernel scheduler but no OOMs. Continuing to monitor.

ops-sre: At +30m: metrics stable. Proceeding with bump to 20%.

santiago: 20% bump complete. No elevated error rate. p95 back to baseline within a few minutes.

emma: Good. Proceed to full ramp at +60m as planned unless objections.

ops-sre: No objections. We'll keep aggressive alerting for the next hour.

deploy-bot: Full rollout scheduled at 1719998400 (T+60min).

emma: Full 100% applied. Monitor dashboards. I'll post final release note summary in 10m. Thanks for quick responses.

ops-sre: Post-cutover check: p95/p99 stable, error rate < 0.2%. No rollback needed. Closing window and marking release notes with final numbers.

emma: Final note: rollout successful. Documenting small transient tail-latency at +3-6m due to cache warm-up, mitigated by bump strategy. If anyone sees anomalies later, post here and escalate. :tada:
